decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting serves a robust specialist niche with long procurement cycles and rising defence demand, and the firm's slack lets it carry the line without an aspiration shortfall.
The spring-balanced desk lamp still supports the ergonomic workplace portfolio with its own page, and there is no evidence of underperformance that would trigger problemistic search.
The second-generation general interior luminaire is a core-business refresh likely meeting aspirations, so withdrawal is unlikely.
As a flagship microprismatic pendant aligned with the firm's direction, it carries strong strategic commitment and is very unlikely to be dropped.
The marine searchlight complements the naval offering, but the earlier withdrawal of the HMI searchlight shows the searchlight segment is under review, which raises its risk slightly.
